title: Doctor Strange Ka Sabse Bara Secret
description:
Doctor Strange Ka Sabse Bara Secret
In this video...
What if Doctor Strange's biggest secret wasn't the 14 million futures... but the one he never told the Avengers?
In this video, we break down an incredible MCU theory connecting Doctor Strange's decision to give Thanos the Time Stone, Steve Rogers' return, Loki becoming the God of Stories, and how it may all lead to Doctor Doom.
Could everything have been part of Strange's master plan from the very beginning?
